{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Eagle Ford Dos Hermanas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from northwest Webb County, Texas to eastern Webb County (Houston Pipeline rich gas gathering system), Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Energy Transfer LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''400 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''50 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2010<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/17284323/etp-announces-two-eagle-ford-gas-pipelines|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/business-news/19102010/Energy_Transfer_Partners_to_construct_two_Eagle_Ford_shale_pipelines|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
